# scripts/capture-cmd 17: real output, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, commit dad6c99, 2026-11-20.
# The reference, unmodified, booted to the test initramfs's shell. A script typed this one line at the guest's shell 2 seconds after start: modprobe virtio_mmio; sleep 1; yes macvmm | tr -d '\n' | head -c 4096 >/tmp/4k; exec 3<>/dev/ttyAMA0; stty raw -echo <&3; dd if=/tmp/4k bs=4096 count=1 2>/dev/null >&3; poweroff -f
# count=1: one 4096-byte write to /dev/ttyAMA0.
# Regenerate with scripts/capture-cmd (course/STYLE.md appendix A); never edit by hand.
$ cargo run -q -p macvmm -- run --kernel .cache/macvmm/Image-virt --initrd .cache/macvmm/initramfs-test.img --mem 512M --console file:hvc0.out --on-reset exit --timeout 30 --stats --cmdline "console=ttyAMA0 earlycon=pl011,0x09000000 panic=-1 quiet"
exit: 0
